questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: If $39\text{ mmol}$ of a solute is dissolved completely to form $40\text{ mL}$ of aqueous solution, what is the molarity of the resulting solution?
questions.explanation: Apply stoichiometric & molar equivalence relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Aldol Condensation & Cannizzaro).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In a quantitative redox conversion, $40\text{ moles}$ of a reagent undergo a change in oxidation number of $5$ units per formula unit. How many Faradays of electricity are required for this conversion?
questions.explanation: Apply stoichiometric & molar equivalence relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Haloform & Tollens Oxidation).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: For a chemical reaction at constant temperature and pressure, $\Delta H^\circ = -410\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$ and $T\Delta S^\circ = +30\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$. What is the standard Gibbs free energy change $\Delta G^\circ$?
questions.solution: $\Delta G^\circ = \Delta H^\circ - T\Delta S^\circ = -410 - 30 = -440\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$.
questions.explanation: Apply thermodynamic & energetic balance relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Clemmensen vs Wolff-Kishner).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Given two elementary thermochemical steps with $\Delta H_1^\circ = +168\text{ kJ/mol}$ and $\Delta H_2^\circ = -42\text{ kJ/mol}$, determine $\Delta H^\circ$ for the overall reaction obtained by $2 \times (\text{Step 1}) + (\text{Step 2})$.
questions.explanation: Apply thermodynamic & energetic balance relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (HVZ & Decarboxylation Kinetics).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: For a reversible elementary reaction $A \rightleftharpoons B$, the forward rate constant is $k_f = 344\text{ s}^{-1}$ and the reverse rate constant is $k_b = 8\text{ s}^{-1}$. Find the equilibrium constant $K_c$.
questions.explanation: Apply equilibrium & extent of reaction relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Aldol Condensation & Cannizzaro).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: One mole of an electrolyte dissociates in solution to yield $2$ ions per formula unit with a degree of dissociation $\alpha = 0.5$. Calculate its Van't Hoff factor $i$.
questions.explanation: Apply equilibrium & extent of reaction relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Haloform & Tollens Oxidation).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A reaction has a constant half-life of $45\text{ min}$ independent of initial concentration. How much time is required for the reactant concentration to fall to $\frac{1}{2^{3}}$ of its initial value?
questions.explanation: Apply kinetic rate & half-life analysis relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Clemmensen vs Wolff-Kishner).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: When the initial concentration of reactant $X$ is increased by a factor of $4$, the initial rate of reaction increases by a factor of $16$. What is the order of the reaction with respect to $X$?
questions.solution: Since $r \propto [X]^n$ and $(4)^n = 16$, the reaction order is $n = 2$.
questions.explanation: Apply kinetic rate & half-life analysis relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (HVZ & Decarboxylation Kinetics).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: How many radial nodes are present in an atomic orbital characterized by principal quantum number $n = 7$ and azimuthal quantum number $l = 4$?
questions.solution: Number of radial nodes $= n - l - 1 = (7) - (4) - 1 = 2$.
questions.explanation: Apply electronic structure & quantum rules relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Aldol Condensation & Cannizzaro).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A transition metal ion in its ground state possesses $n = 6$ unpaired electrons. What is its spin-only magnetic moment in Bohr Magnetons ($\text{BM}$)?
questions.explanation: Apply electronic structure & quantum rules relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Haloform & Tollens Oxidation).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A central main-group atom forms $7$ $\sigma$-bonds with surrounding monovalent atoms and retains $1$ non-bonding lone pair. What is the steric number of the central atom?
questions.explanation: Apply bonding, hybridization & polarity relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Clemmensen vs Wolff-Kishner).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A homonuclear diatomic species contains $10$ electrons in bonding molecular orbitals and $6$ electrons in antibonding molecular orbitals. What is its bond order?
questions.explanation: Apply bonding, hybridization & polarity relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (HVZ & Decarboxylation Kinetics).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In a binary ideal liquid mixture at constant temperature, pure liquid $A$ has vapor pressure $P_A^\circ = 1020\text{ Torr}$ and its mole fraction in the liquid phase is $x_A = 0.5$. Find the partial vapor pressure of $A$ above the solution.
questions.solution: By Raoult's law, $P_A = x_A P_A^\circ = 0.5 \times 1020 = 510\text{ Torr}$.
questions.explanation: Apply colligative & phase behavior relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Aldol Condensation & Cannizzaro).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A dilute solution of a non-volatile non-electrolyte has molality $m = 3\text{ mol kg}^{-1}$ in a solvent with $K_b = 0.52\text{ K kg mol}^{-1}$. Calculate the elevation in boiling point $\Delta T_b$.
questions.explanation: Apply colligative & phase behavior relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Haloform & Tollens Oxidation).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In a galvanic cell at $298\text{ K}$, the standard reduction potentials of the cathode and anode half-cells are $+5.30\text{ V}$ and $-0.40\text{ V}$ respectively. Determine $E_{\text{cell}}^\circ$.
questions.explanation: Apply electrochemical potential & nernst relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Clemmensen vs Wolff-Kishner).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: At $298\text{ K}$ (where $\frac{2.303 RT}{F} = 0.059\text{ V}$), an $n$-electron redox half-reaction has $n = 5$. How does the electrode potential change when the reaction quotient $Q$ increases by a factor of $10^{5}$?
questions.explanation: Apply electrochemical potential & nernst relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (HVZ & Decarboxylation Kinetics).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In the polyatomic oxo-anion $\text{XO}_{6}^{2-}$ where each oxygen atom is in the $-2$ oxidation state, what is the oxidation state of the central atom $\text{X}$?
questions.solution: Let oxidation state of $\text{X}$ be $x$: $x + 6(-2) = -2 \implies x = +10$.
questions.explanation: Apply periodic trends & oxidation states relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Aldol Condensation & Cannizzaro).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: If the effective nuclear charge $Z_{\text{eff}}$ increases by $0.65$ units for each unit increase in atomic number across a period, what is the cumulative increase in $Z_{\text{eff}}$ across $7$ consecutive main-group elements in that period?
questions.solution: Across 7 consecutive elements there are 6 steps, giving $\Delta Z_{\text{eff}} = 0.65 \times 6 = 3.90$.
questions.explanation: Apply periodic trends & oxidation states relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Haloform & Tollens Oxidation).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: An octahedral complex $[\text{M}(\text{L})_6]^{n+}$ containing a $d^1$ metal ion has an octahedral splitting parameter $\Delta_o = 57000\text{ cm}^{-1}$. What is the magnitude of its Crystal Field Stabilization Energy?
questions.solution: For $t_{2g}^1 e_g^0$ in an octahedral field, $|\text{CFSE}| = 0.4\Delta_o = 22800\text{ cm}^{-1}$.
questions.explanation: Apply coordination & crystal field theory relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Clemmensen vs Wolff-Kishner).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A neutral chelating ligand of denticity $2$ forms a homoleptic complex with a metal ion whose coordination number is $4$. How many ligand molecules are coordinated to the metal ion?
questions.explanation: Apply coordination & crystal field theory relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (HVZ & Decarboxylation Kinetics).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: An unsymmetrical organic molecule possesses $n = 2$ chiral centers and has no plane, center, or alternating axis of symmetry. How many optically active stereoisomers can it form?
questions.solution: For an unsymmetrical molecule with $n = 2$ chiral centers, total optically active isomers $= 2^n = 4$.
questions.explanation: Apply stereochemistry & isomeric counting relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Aldol Condensation & Cannizzaro).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: What is the Degree of Unsaturation (Double Bond Equivalent) of a hydrocarbon having the molecular formula $\text{C}_{60}\text{H}_{118}$?
questions.explanation: Apply stereochemistry & isomeric counting relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Haloform & Tollens Oxidation).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In a two-step synthesis starting from $61\text{ moles}$ of reactant, the first step has an $80\%$ yield and the second step has a $75\%$ yield. How many moles of final product are isolated?
questions.solution: Overall yield $= 0.80 \times 0.75 = 0.60$. Moles of product $= 0.60 \times 61 = 36.60\text{ mol}$.
questions.explanation: Apply reaction mechanism & selectivity relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (Clemmensen vs Wolff-Kishner).

questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.explanation: Apply reaction mechanism & selectivity relations in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (HVZ & Decarboxylation Kinetics).

questions.explanation: Apply numerical stoichiometric equivalents in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Three consecutive steps of a thermochemical cycle have enthalpy changes $+160\text{ kJ}$, $-5\text{ kJ}$, and $+10\text{ kJ}$. Calculate the net enthalpy change $\Delta H_{\text{net}}$ in kJ.
questions.explanation: Apply numerical enthalpy & free energy in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: How many atomic orbitals in total (excluding electron spin) belong to the principal quantum shell $n = 6$?
questions.explanation: Apply numerical quantum & nodal count in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In the homoleptic metal carbonyl $\text{M}(\text{CO})_{7}$, each $\text{CO}$ ligand donates $2$ electrons to the metal center. What is the total number of electrons donated by the ligands?
questions.explanation: Apply numerical oxidation & coordination number in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids.

questions.question: Determine the Degree of Unsaturation (DBE) of an organic compound having the molecular formula $\text{C}_{51}\text{H}_{86}\text{O}_2$.
questions.explanation: Apply numerical degree of unsaturation in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids.

questions.explanation: Apply numerical kinetics & half-life in Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids.
